nodes.name: Chronopotentiometry Cu(OH)₂ NW growth
nodes.procedure: The Cu(OH)₂ NWs were first grown on CF by a chronopotentiometry method at a constant current of 20 mA cm⁻² in a 2 M KOH solution.
nodes.source_text: The Cu(OH)₂ NWs were first grown on CF by a chronopotentiometry method at a constant current of 20 mA cm⁻² in a 2 M KOH solution.

nodes.name: Low-temperature phosphorylation
nodes.procedure: 500 mg of sodium hypophosphite powder was placed upstream of the tube furnace, and Cu(OH)₂ NWs/CF was placed downstream. The sodium hypophosphite was heated in an argon flow at a rate of 2°C min⁻¹ and maintained at 300°C for 1 h. After that, the product was naturally cooled to ambient temperature.

unit_operations.name: Phosphorylation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: The sodium hypophosphite was heated in an argon flow at a rate of 2°C min⁻¹ and maintained at 300°C for 1 h.

nodes.source_text: 500 mg of sodium hypophosphite powder was placed upstream... maintained at 300°C for 1 h. After that, the product was naturally cooled to ambient temperature.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition CoFe-LDH (300s)
nodes.procedure: 0.2 M Co(NO₃)₂ and 0.1 M FeSO₄ were uniformly dissolved in 35 mL of deionized (DI) water as the deposition solution. Deposition was performed under N₂ protection by applying a constant potential of -1.0 V versus saturated calomel electrode for 300 s, to obtain a loading amount of 4.7 mg cm⁻². The sample was denoted as Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF.
nodes.source_text: 0.2 M Co(NO₃)₂ and 0.1 M FeSO₄ were uniformly dissolved in 35 mL of deionized (DI) water... for 300 s, to obtain a loading amount of 4.7 mg cm⁻². The sample was denoted as Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF.

nodes.description: OER performance in oxygen-saturated 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: The OER performances... were evaluated in oxygen-saturated 1.0 M KOH using a standard three-electrode system... The overpotential of Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF is only 293 mV at 100mAcm⁻²... Tafel slope of 45.08 mV dec⁻¹... charge-transfer resistance... 0.246 Ω

Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF also has extremely active electrocatalytic properties for HER in 1 M KOH... low overpotential of 181.4 mV at a current density of 100mAcm⁻². The Tafel slope... 37.21mVdec⁻¹... charge-transfer resistance (0.435 Ω)

nodes.description: Overall water splitting (OWS) in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: an applied voltage of only 1.452 V is required to reach 10mAcm⁻²... the final FEs of the anode and cathode are both approximately 100%... very stable OWS behavior at a current density of 10mAcm⁻²... at a much higher current density of 100mAcm⁻², the attenuation of the current density is less than 0.3% after consecutive 50 h measurements

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows CoFe-LDH nanosheets attached to Cu₃P nanowires forming core-shell structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SEM image of Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF is shown in Figure 1a. Clearly, a large number of CoFe-LDH nanosheets are attached to the Cu₃P NWs...

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM confirms Cu₃P nanowire surrounded by CoFe-LDH nanosheets forming heterogeneous interface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The core-shell structure of Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF was further characterized by TEM. As depicted in Figure 1b, the Cu₃P NW is surrounded by a large number of CoFe-LDH nanosheets...

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows lattice fringes of 0.38 nm (CoFe-LDH (006)) and 0.248 nm (Cu₃P (112)).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The lattice fringe spacings of 0.38 and 0.248 nm, corresponding to the (006) crystal plane of CoFe-LDH and the (112) crystal plane of Cu₃P, are found from the high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) images (Figure 1c).

nodes.characterization_summary: Elemental mapping shows uniform distribution of Cu, P, Co, Fe, and O elements.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Elemental mapping studies were used to evaluate the spatial distribution of elements. The results display that Cu, P, Co, Fe, and O elements are equally spaced in Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF...

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows Cu₃P peaks plus (003), (012), (110) peaks of hydrotalcite-like LDH at 11.66°, 34.13°, 59.00°; no impurity phases.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XRD patterns of as-prepared Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF... besides the characteristic diffraction peaks coming from Cu₃P, three additional diffraction peaks at 11.66°, 34.13°, and 59.00° appear... No impurity phases can be found...

nodes.characterization_summary: Band gaps of 1.58 eV (Cu₃P) and 1.93 eV (CoFe-LDH) from Kubelka-Munk plots.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The corresponding band gaps (E_g) were obtained from Kubelka-Munk plots. They were 1.58 and 1.93 eV for Cu₃P and CoFe-LDH, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: M-S plots show p-type Cu₃P (negative slope, E_f=1.56 V), n-type CoFe-LDH (positive slope, E_f=-0.17 V), heterostructure confirmed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The M-S plots (Figure 3c-e) show the negative slope for Cu₃P and the positive slope for CoFe-LDH... Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF shows an inverted V-shaped curve...

nodes.characterization_summary: Cu 2p: 932.41 eV (Cu⁺ 2p3/2), 953.52 eV (Cu⁺ 2p1/2); P 2p: 133.15 eV (P-O), 128.52 eV (Cu-P); Co 2p: 781.13 eV, 797.19 eV (Co²⁺); Fe 2p: 711.50 eV, 724.82 eV (Fe³⁺); O 1s: 529.59 eV (M-O), 531.13 eV (M-OH), 532.28 eV (adsorbed H₂O). Peak shifts indicate electron flow from CoFe-LDH to Cu₃P.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The surface composition and elemental valence of Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF were explored by XPS... Notably, compared to CoFe-LDH/CF and Cu₃P/CF, the peaks of Cu 2p and P 2p in Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF move to low binding energy...

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance C_dl = 15.76 mF cm⁻² calculated from CV in 1.0-1.1 V vs RHE, corresponding to ECSA = C_dl / 0.04 mF cm⁻².
nodes.evidence_snippet: The cyclic voltammetry (CV) measurements were carried out in the potential ranges of 1.0-1.1... Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF shows a quite large C_dl value of 15.76 mF cm⁻² (Figure S4f).

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance C_dl = 33.97 mF cm⁻² calculated from CV in 0.323-0.224 V vs RHE, corresponding to ECSA = C_dl / 0.04 mF cm⁻².
nodes.evidence_snippet: The cyclic voltammetry (CV) measurements were carried out in the potential ranges of... 0.323-0.224 V vs RHE... Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF shows a quite large C_dl (33.97 mF cm⁻²).

nodes.characterization_summary: Charge-transfer resistance R_ct = 0.246 Ω for OER; 0.435 Ω for HER.
nodes.evidence_snippet: It was observed that the charge-transfer resistance is the smallest for Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF (0.246 Ω)... Compared to CoFe-LDH/CF (0.542 Ω), Cu₃P (1.141 Ω), and CF(23.89 Ω), Cu₃P@CoFe-LDH/CF possesses a smaller charge-transfer resistance (0.435 Ω)...
